cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys, os, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import gen, run_tests
counter = collections.Counter()
for seed in range(200):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    request = gen.make_request(rng, big=(seed%5==4))
    proc = run_tests.run(request)
    resp = json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())
    if 'error' in resp: counter['ERROR']+=1; continue
    for case, res in zip(request['cases'], resp['cases']):
        for ev, out in zip(case['events'], res['events']):
            counter['op:'+ev['op']] += 1
            if out['op']=='deliver': counter['disp:'+out['status']] += 1
            if out['op']=='step':
                counter['step:'+out['status']] += 1
                if out['status']=='waiting':
                    if out['missing']: counter['block:missing']+=1
                    if out['stale']: counter['block:stale']+=1
                    if not out['missing'] and not out['stale']: counter['block:fresh-only']+=1
            if out['op']=='issue':
                counter['prop:'+out['result']['status']]+=1
                if out['result']['status']=='optimal':
                    nz = sum(1 for row in out['result']['flow'] for v in row if v!=0.0)
                    counter['nonzero-flows' if nz else 'all-zero-flows']+=1
                    pot = [abs(v) for v in out['result']['potential']]
                    if pot and max(pot)>1e-9: counter['nonzero-potential']+=1
                    if pot and min(pot)==0.0 and max(pot)>0: counter['mixed-potential']+=1
                else:
                    counter['unroutable>1' if len(out['result']['unroutable'])>1 else 'unroutable==1']+=1
            if out['op']=='step' and out['status']=='advanced':
                counter['ceiling>0' if out['ceiling']>0 else 'ceiling==0']+=1
                if any(v!=0 for v in out['pressure']): counter['pressure>0']+=1
                if any(v<0 for v in out['z']): counter['z<0']+=1
                if any(v!=0 for v in out['dual']): counter['dual!=0']+=1
            if out['op']=='audit':
                if any(a is not None for a in out['age']): counter['age-not-null']+=1
for k in sorted(counter): print('%-24s %d' % (k, counter[k]))
PYEOF
